review_scope: TUI replay store, distinct from 3F.76 live FIFO acceptance
source_trace: thread_events.rs: ensure_live_event_budget returns a serialized per-event result, used by live queue; it does not enforce total replay retention
thread_event_buffer.rs: evict_overflowing_events only checks buffer.length and aggregated AgentMessageDelta bytes
thread_events.rs: snapshot clones the retained replay events and the session/turns, causing transient memory amplification
thread_events.rs: raw response items and realtime audio/SDP are excluded from the replay buffer before push; this is necessary but not sufficient for all other rich event payloads

pending_interactive_replay.rs: note_evicted_server_request removes the request from pending approval/input bookkeeping when the corresponding replay buffer event is evicted; a simple byte cap with the existing FIFO eviction rule can prematurely forget inactive-thread prompts
impact: Multiple individually legal rich notifications, request payloads or completed items may accumulate beyond any stated per-thread aggregate replay byte ceiling. Do not infer one from the 2 MiB live event limit.
requirements_before_owner_acceptance: Exercise pending interactive approval/elicitation/user-input preservation under inactive-thread replay retention pressure; an eviction policy must either retain the protected request or surface an explicit fail-closed error rather than silently forgetting a pending prompt
Define and enforce an explicit aggregate retained-byte budget for all replay event variants, with bounded counting that does not allocate a second copy of large event payloads
Keep ordered live delivery and fail-closed overflow semantics intact; do not silently discard trusted approvals, tool permission requests, terminal events or adaptive terminal signals
Demonstrate correct accounting for coalesced delta text, replay filtering/session refresh, per-event eviction and thread switch snapshots
Retain protection for voice privacy and raw response/audio exclusion; no credentials, history or realtime voice payload should be retained unnecessarily
Prove saturation, oversized rich payload and snapshot behavior via source-bound native Windows regression tests; re-run the previously green 36-case queue/TUI acceptance
Review total memory of retained turns/session separately; an event-only budget must not be represented as a process-wide cap
Formal owner approval is still required; no green test alone promotes this hold
notes: Risk evidence only; does not modify runtime or waive the existing 13-path semantic hold ledger.
additional_risk: Current FIFO capacity eviction can already clear pending-request tracking via note_evicted_server_request. Increasing eviction frequency for a new byte budget without an authority-preserving policy could worsen an existing prompt-loss scenario.
